title: Global sections generating a module
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module and $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal F)$ global sections. For each $i$ let $\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal F$ be the map associated to $s_i$ (on an open $U$ it sends $f\in\mathcal O_Y(U)$ to $f\cdot s_i|_U$). The sections $s_0,\dots,s_n$ *generate* $\mathcal F$ if the map

$$
\bigoplus_{i=0}^n\mathcal O_Y\longrightarrow\mathcal F,\qquad (f_0,\dots,f_n)\longmapsto\textstyle\sum_i f_is_i,
$$

which is the map associated to $s_i$ on the $i$-th summand, is surjective as a map of sheaves: for every open $U\subseteq Y$ and every $t\in\mathcal F(U)$ there is an open covering $U=\bigcup_k U_k$ such that each $t|_{U_k}$ is of the form $\sum_if_is_i|_{U_k}$ with $f_i\in\mathcal O_Y(U_k)$. $\mathcal F$ is *generated by global sections* if some family of global sections generates it.
